notes.title: Patch Notes - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug in the [b]Main Menu[/b] where players couldn't interact without a controller.

- Fixed a bug in the [b]Pause Menu[/b] where players couldn't interact without a controller.

- Fixed a bug where players could stack a jump mid-air, allowing the character to jump again immediately 
after touching the floor.

- Fixed a bug where the player could jump in the middle of an interaction, reaching the ceiling.

- Fixed a bug where heart containers would reset incorrectly after loading the game.

- Fixed a bug where dying at the beginning of the game would cause it to reset improperly.

- Fixed a bug where the player couldn't use the bottle to interact if it was in the right item slot.
